decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program fits closely with the firm's established mental-health capabilities, and its dedicated page suggests enough early promise to keep this option open while uncertainty is still resolving.

The carpentry workshop uses the firm's practical therapy and production know-how, and despite higher operating intensity its dedicated-page presence supports continued learning before abandoning the option.
The outpatient sociotherapy service is close to the core offer and likely relatively inexpensive to continue, so real-options logic favors keeping it until demand becomes clearer.
The counseling service for senior living is both close to core eldercare activities and prominently shown on the home page, indicating enough strategic relevance to continue.
The retail shop is more peripheral than the care-related services, shows weaker website support, and likely carries enough ongoing retail costs that resources are better redeployed elsewhere.
